data_description.restore_codec_after_talk: If DMSS crackles on G.711A: G.711A only while Home Assistant talks. Disables the codec watchdog.
data_description.fix_sub_stream_audio: WebRTC players cannot play the VTO's default PCM 16 kHz sound. Keeps the sub stream (subtype=1) audio on and in G.711A 8 kHz.
